summary: Backend-only testing for Shennell iteration 2 (Missions + Stripe + SUNO export). Built /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_extras.py — 11 new tests, ALL PASSED (11/11) against https://multi-agent-ai-43.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: GET /api/missions/presets returns all 5 presets (fda_awareness_pack, hollywood_3hr, music_video, crypto_audit, business_formation) with correct shape (key/name/tagline/agents/color/icon/step_count). POST /api/missions/launch with crypto_audit completed end-to-end in ~22s — 4 steps populated with real non-empty AXIOM + CIPHER outputs, status='complete'. GET /api/missions/{id} and GET /api/missions?user_id work and return persisted data. POST /api/stripe/checkout (elite) returned a real checkout_url starting with https://checkout.stripe.com/ and session_id starting with cs_test_; invalid plan='free' correctly returns 400; GET /api/stripe/status for a brand-new user returns plan='essential', status='none'. Regression: GET /api/templates returns 6 templates (lexis, cipher, nova, axiom, terra, suno); POST /api/shennell/chat returns in-character response (matched 'darling/babe/lover/honey'). No MongoDB _id leakage in any response. NOTE: backend logs show that POST /api/stripe/checkout returned 502 Bad Gateway multiple times during the iteration (intermittent Emergent Stripe proxy failures); our test got a 200 on first attempt but main agent should be aware this endpoint is occasionally flaky.

minor.issue: Observed several 502 Bad Gateway responses in /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log earlier in the iteration before our run. Endpoint succeeded in our test pass, but the underlying Emergent Stripe proxy appears intermittently unreliable. Consider adding a single retry (1x with 1s backoff) inside _stripe_call() for transient 502s, or surface a clearer user-facing error.

Orchestration runs SYNCHRONOUSLY inside the request handler — caller blocks for 30-60s for crypto_audit (4 steps) and could exceed 2+ minutes for hollywood_3hr (7 steps). Recommend backgrounding with FastAPI BackgroundTasks or returning 202 + polling GET /api/missions/{id}. Current code is correct but UX/timeout-risky.

On any step failure the partial mission is marked status='failed' but already-completed steps are not surfaced in the response cleanly (returns whatever was appended). Add per-step status='failed'/'skipped' explicitly for downstream UI.

Not exercised in the launch spec but exists in extras.py. The body is accessed via request.json() instead of a Pydantic model — no schema validation, missing user_id silently becomes None. Consider a SunoExportRequest BaseModel for consistency with the rest of the API.

action_items: Make POST /api/missions/launch asynchronous (BackgroundTasks) and have clients poll GET /api/missions/{id} — current sync orchestration blocks the HTTP request 30-120s+.
Add a 1x retry in extras.py::_stripe_call for transient 502 responses from the Emergent Stripe proxy (observed several 502s in backend logs).
Convert /api/agents/{id}/suno-export to use a Pydantic request model.
(Inherited from iter1) Migrate FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') to lifespan handler; consider passing chat history natively rather than packing into a single user prompt.
critical_code_review_comments: extras.py:224 — launch_mission runs the entire LLM chain inside the request handler. For 5+ step presets (hollywood_3hr=7 steps) this risks Kubernetes ingress / proxy timeouts. Use BackgroundTasks or asyncio.create_task and respond 202 immediately with the mission id.
extras.py:286 — bare except in launch_mission swallows the failing step's index; the saved mission has no record of which step blew up. Persist a 'failed_step_index' and the exception message.
extras.py:319 — create_checkout: prices/plans hardcoded. Move to a PLANS constant near top-of-file for discoverability.
extras.py:402 — suno_export uses raw request.json() instead of a Pydantic model; inconsistent with rest of API and skips validation.
server.py:560 — still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager.
server.py:305-333 — run_chat() packs history into a single user prompt (good for cost) but means the LLM cannot distinguish multi-turn dynamics as well as a true messages array. Acceptable trade-off.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11) — iter2 suite. Combined with iter1 (21/21) = 32/32 across both suites.

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_-prefixed user_ids per test; missions and subscription docs are written to Mongo but tied to unique randomized user_ids so they don't collide. No cleanup performed (test data is namespaced and harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 backend fully operational. All 11 new tests pass. Backend URL: https://multi-agent-ai-43.preview.emergentagent.com (also exposed as EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env). Mission crypto_audit takes ~20-25s end-to-end; hollywood_3hr will likely take 60-120s and could hit ingress timeouts — main agent should consider backgrounding before testing it. Stripe checkout via Emergent proxy is occasionally flaky (502s observed in logs) — single retry recommended. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_extras.py -v. Iter1 suite (test_shennell_backend.py) was NOT re-run this iteration but no regressions expected — server.py changes were additive (extras router only).
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. The intermittent 502s on /api/stripe/checkout originate upstream in the Emergent Stripe proxy (502 surfaces from extras.py::_stripe_call when r.status_code >= 400). Reproduction: send 5-10 consecutive POST /api/stripe/checkout calls — some will return 502. Mitigation: add a 1-retry with 1s backoff inside _stripe_call() before raising.
